webster.text: To regard with respect and reverence; to reverence; to revere.

example.quote: Sir, I venerate the spirit with which every thing was done at the trying time in which the Confederation was formed.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 23, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
